# Ocean Breeze Costa Rica

> Family-owned private tourist transportation and guided tours in Guanacaste, Costa Rica. Authorized by CTP and ICT.

Ocean Breeze Transport and Tourism is a legal, licensed private transfer and tour company based in Guanacaste. The operator is Sergio de Jesús Arrieta Fonseca (ID 3-0438-0812). The authorized vehicle is minibus plate GB-003813 (Ford Transit 2020, 15 passengers), with Dekra inspection and INS insurance.

## Services
Private transportation (airport–hotel, 24/7) and full-day tours in Guanacaste, including beaches, Arenal, Monteverde, Río Celeste, Palo Verde, La Leona Waterfall, and more.

## Permits
- CTP Special Stable Tourism Permit TUR-0045327, File TU-2073, valid 27 Oct 2025–30 Sep 2027, nationwide
- ICT Registration Code 4100-2025
- In process of licensing with Country Brand esencial Costa Rica
